notes: `מֵרָחוֹק` → *afar off* is retained as one two-morpheme unit: the ASV spends no word on either morpheme in particular, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and the contiguous pair fuses, headed on the noun carrying the lexeme (rules 30, 40). Splitting *off* onto the `מִן` is the named competing reading.
The `לְ` of `לְרֵעִי` is `unrepresented`: the ASV writes *understandest my thought* with no preposition for its own relation (rule 40).
